background: Secure Trust Bank is a UK specialist lender listed in London, funded by retail savings and lending on vehicle finance, retail point-of-sale finance, real-estate development and commercial finance.
synthesis: The bank holds no public rating from any of the three main agencies. Leverage of 10.3% is at the median of UK small banks and well above what larger lenders run, but CET1 of 14.3% is in the bottom quarter, reflecting the risk weight of its consumer and development lending. Both have improved since 31 Dec 2023, CET1 up 1.6 points and leverage up 0.6 points, while LCR of 209% is below the median and broadly flat. The news is positive, with a rise in first-half profit reported on 3 Oct 2026.
